claims.text: Steven Aftergood joined FAS in 1989 and directed its Project on Government Secrecy from 1991 to 2021.

Aftergood was plaintiff in a 1997 FOIA suit against the CIA that resulted in declassification and release of the total US intelligence budget for the first time in fifty years, $26.6 billion for FY1997.
Aftergood won a 2006 FOIA suit against the National Reconnaissance Office securing release of unclassified budget records.
